thread.title: Amazon stock surges to surpass Microsoft as most valuable U.S. company - MarketWatch

author: Wallace Witkowski
title: Amazon stock surges to surpass Microsoft as most valuable U.S. company - MarketWatch

organizations.name: et share wallace witkowski reporter amazon.com inc

text: Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, +3.44% shares rallied Monday to unseat Microsoft Corp. MSFT, +0.13% as the most valuable U.S. company based on market capitalization. Amazon shares surged 3.4% to close at $1,629.51 for a market cap of $796.78 billion, while shares of Microsoft ticked 0.1% higher to close at $102.06 for a market cap of $783.57 billion. Microsoft had unseated Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.22% as the most valuable U.S. company at the end of November . Over the past six trading days, Amazon's stock has rallied more than 11% to catapult the company from fourth place to first after tacking on $74.1 billion in market cap, according to Dow Jones data. Apple closed in fourth place at $701.99 billion following a 0.2% decline, and Alphabet Inc. GOOGL, -0.20% GOOG, -0.22% held in third place with a cap of $745.63 billion after Monday's 0.2% decline. In Monday's broader market, the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.42% rose 0.4%, the S&P 500 index SPX, +0.70% advanced 0.7%, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +1.26% gained 0.9%.
